provenance.source: PR #848 fix: recover from nested panics in Sequence and Batch commands, merged 2025-09-11
provenance.note: introduced by the PR: it extracted the batch and sequence code into execBatchMsg and execSequenceMsg and, in the same move, dropped the setWindowTitleMsg and windowSizeMsg cases the loop used to handle; the later fix re-adds both under the switch and says it fixes this merge. A SetWindowTitle command now falls through to Update and the title is never written, and a WindowSize command never re-checks the terminal size

keywords: falls through to the user's Update
the switch lost its internal cases
internal messages are no longer handled
bugs.note: the switch in eventLoop handles QuitMsg, the renderer messages, execMsg, BatchMsg and sequenceMsg, and nothing else: the window title and window size messages it no longer names fall through to model.View's caller, so the OSC 2 title sequence is never emitted and go p.checkResize() never runs
